digest.component_or_area: authorship fixture / batched ticket map resolver
propositions: The fixture-level batched map resolver returns empty on transient Git subprocess failures (rc128, rc0 with empty stdout, or EAGAIN) even though production callers fall back per-event successfully.

The test harness incorrectly treated a single raw call to build_ticket_position_commit_map as guaranteed non-empty, violating the documented contract that explicitly returns {} on any Git/process/empty-output failure.

Injected first-attempt transient boundaries (rc128/empty, rc0/empty, BlockingIOError EAGAIN) each reproduce the observed sequence: empty batched result followed by successful identical replay against the unchanged repository.
The test must use bounded recovery with at most five exact resolver attempts and persistent failure diagnostics, while production authorship source and per-event fallback semantics remain unchanged.

The prior loose-object ENOENT mechanism is refuted: deleting the implicated blob leaves both broad and narrow history reads successful, proving this transient batched-empty signature is a separate defect class.
